cases.name: Queued claim survives connectivity outage and duplicate enqueue
Restart before dispatch releases expired fenced claim and executes once
Ambiguous dispatched claim is not replayed after restart
Permanent dispatched operation failure is terminal and observable

spendEvidence: No inference is dispatched in this queue certification; inference/accounting idempotency is separately certified.
limitations: Real ECONNREFUSED is injected before the isolated SQLite claim authority. No production Postgres connection is interrupted.

Permanent claim-store failure remains queued with observable bounded errors until the worker stops; it is never mislabeled completed. Permanent dispatched operation failure is independently shown as terminal failed.
The restarted authorities share durable database state but this harness does not kill its operating system process; actual parent process/server kills are certified separately.
